response.justification: Bogdan is an exceptional software engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure skills, plus current hands-on experience with MCP and agentic workflows at re:cinq. However, he critically lacks the required 8+ years of AI-driven solutions experience—his GenAI work is recent (6 months). He also has no documented Python expertise, vector database knowledge, or RAG architecture experience. While his current trajectory and technical leadership capabilities are promising, he appears to be a senior generalist engineer recently pivoting into GenAI rather than a Staff-level AI specialist ready to lead complex production AI systems.
strengths: Strong TypeScript/Node.js expertise and AWS cloud platform experience across senior roles at multiple companies
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq, demonstrating active engagement with core job technologies
Proven staff-level technical leadership with consistent mentoring, knowledge-sharing, and ability to guide teams across domains
concerns: Does not meet the core requirement of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions; GenAI experience is limited to ~6 months at current role
No Python experience documented despite it being a required language; missing expertise in vector databases and RAG architectures entirely
No evidence of deep LLM/AI domain knowledge such as performance metrics, optimization techniques, or experience with multi-agent frameworks like LangGraph/CrewAI

key_factors.factor: Recent GenAI work and MCP experience
Strong TypeScript and cloud infrastructure foundation
